title: How to pay your service charge online
vo: Paying your estate service charge takes about a minute, and you get a receipt.
First, open your estate's sign-in link, and sign in with your phone number and four-digit PIN.
Next, open Bills. You'll see what you owe, and when it's due.
To pay, transfer from any Nigerian bank app to the estate account shown on the page.
Add your unit reference to the narration, so the payment lands against your home.
Want fewer reminders? Pay a few months ahead, and you won't be billed for them again.
One last thing. If you are ever asked to pay into a new account, call a committee member first.
music: About one minute of original, calm instrumental background music for a friendly how-to video. Warm West African flavour: soft hand percussion, light shaker, clean guitar picking, mellow keys. Relaxed tempo around 96 BPM, even dynamics so a voice can sit on top, no vocals, a soft resolved ending.
